description: This file declares the API functions for storm control filtering in the Realtek RTL8367C switch driver. It includes function prototypes for enabling/disabling storm control features, setting meters, and retrieving status related to broadcast, multicast, and unknown unicast traffic filtering.

methods.name: rtl8367c_setAsicStormFilterBroadcastEnable
methods.description: Sets whether broadcast storm filtering is enabled on a specific port.

methods.name: rtl8367c_getAsicStormFilterBroadcastEnable
methods.description: Retrieves whether broadcast storm filtering is enabled on a specific port.

methods.name: rtl8367c_setAsicStormFilterBroadcastMeter
methods.description: Configures the meter for broadcast storm filtering on a specific port.

methods.name: rtl8367c_getAsicStormFilterBroadcastMeter
methods.description: Retrieves the current broadcast storm filter meter setting for a port.

methods.name: rtl8367c_setAsicStormFilterMulticastEnable
methods.description: Enables or disables multicast storm filtering on a port.

methods.name: rtl8367c_getAsicStormFilterMulticastEnable
methods.description: Checks if multicast storm filtering is enabled on a port.

methods.name: rtl8367c_setAsicStormFilterMulticastMeter
methods.description: Sets the meter for multicast storm filtering on a port.

methods.name: rtl8367c_getAsicStormFilterMulticastMeter
methods.description: Gets the multicast storm filter meter value for a port.

methods.name: rtl8367c_setAsicStormFilterUnknownMulticastEnable
methods.description: Enables or disables unknown multicast storm filtering on a port.

methods.name: rtl8367c_getAsicStormFilterUnknownMulticastEnable
methods.description: Checks if unknown multicast storm filtering is enabled on a port.

methods.name: rtl8367c_setAsicStormFilterUnknownMulticastMeter
methods.description: Sets the meter for unknown multicast storm filtering.

methods.name: rtl8367c_getAsicStormFilterUnknownMulticastMeter
methods.description: Retrieves the meter value used for unknown multicast storm filtering.

methods.name: rtl8367c_setAsicStormFilterUnknownUnicastEnable
methods.description: Enables or disables unknown unicast storm filtering.

methods.name: rtl8367c_getAsicStormFilterUnknownUnicastEnable
methods.description: Checks if unknown unicast storm filtering is enabled.

methods.name: rtl8367c_setAsicStormFilterUnknownUnicastMeter
methods.description: Sets the meter for unknown unicast storm filtering.

methods.name: rtl8367c_getAsicStormFilterUnknownUnicastMeter
methods.description: Retrieves the meter setting for unknown unicast storm filtering.

methods.name: rtl8367c_setAsicStormFilterExtBroadcastMeter
methods.description: Sets meter for external broadcast storm filtering.

methods.name: rtl8367c_getAsicStormFilterExtBroadcastMeter
methods.description: Retrieves external broadcast storm filter meter.

methods.name: rtl8367c_setAsicStormFilterExtMulticastMeter
methods.description: Sets meter for external multicast storm filtering.

methods.name: rtl8367c_getAsicStormFilterExtMulticastMeter
methods.description: Retrieves external multicast storm filter meter.

methods.name: rtl8367c_setAsicStormFilterExtUnknownMulticastMeter
methods.description: Sets meter for external unknown multicast storm filtering.

methods.name: rtl8367c_getAsicStormFilterExtUnknownMulticastMeter
methods.description: Retrieves external unknown multicast storm filter meter.

methods.name: rtl8367c_setAsicStormFilterExtUnknownUnicastMeter
methods.description: Sets meter for external unknown unicast storm filtering.

methods.name: rtl8367c_getAsicStormFilterExtUnknownUnicastMeter
methods.description: Retrieves external unknown unicast storm filter meter.

methods.name: rtl8367c_setAsicStormFilterExtBroadcastEnable
methods.description: Enables or disables external broadcast storm filtering.

methods.name: rtl8367c_getAsicStormFilterExtBroadcastEnable
methods.description: Checks if external broadcast storm filtering is enabled.

methods.name: rtl8367c_setAsicStormFilterExtMulticastEnable
methods.description: Enables or disables external multicast storm filtering.

methods.name: rtl8367c_getAsicStormFilterExtMulticastEnable
methods.description: Checks if external multicast storm filtering is enabled.

methods.name: rtl8367c_setAsicStormFilterExtUnknownMulticastEnable
methods.description: Enables or disables external unknown multicast storm filtering.

methods.name: rtl8367c_getAsicStormFilterExtUnknownMulticastEnable
methods.description: Checks external unknown multicast storm filtering status.

methods.name: rtl8367c_setAsicStormFilterExtUnknownUnicastEnable
methods.description: Enables or disables external unknown unicast storm filtering.

methods.name: rtl8367c_getAsicStormFilterExtUnknownUnicastEnable
methods.description: Checks if external unknown unicast storm filtering is enabled.

methods.name: rtl8367c_setAsicStormFilterExtEnablePortMask
methods.description: Configures port mask for external storm filters.

methods.name: rtl8367c_getAsicStormFilterExtEnablePortMask
methods.description: Retrieves port mask configuration for external storm filters.
